CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER,
      user_email TEXT,
      action TEXT NOT NULL,
      entity TEXT NOT NULL,
      entity_id TEXT,
      details TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE `contact_messages` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`email` text NOT NULL,
	`message` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL
, `consent` integer DEFAULT true, `consent_timestamp` text, `email_delivery_failed` integer DEFAULT false)

CREATE TABLE `episodes` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`slug` text NOT NULL,
	`youtube_url` text,
	`youtube_video_id` text,
	`fallback_watch_url` text,
	`short_summary` text NOT NULL,
	`description` text NOT NULL,
	`thumbnail_id` integer,
	`episode_number` numeric,
	`season` numeric,
	`published_at` text NOT NULL,
	`transcript` text,
	`featured` integer DEFAULT false,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
	`seo_title` text,
	`seo_description` text,
	`canonical_override` text,
	`updated_at` text DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`thumbnail_id`) REFERENCES `media`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null
)

CREATE TABLE `episodes_key_takeaways` (
	`_order` integer NOT NULL,
	`_parent_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`takeaway` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`_parent_id`) REFERENCES `episodes`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

CREATE TABLE `episodes_quotes` (
	`_order` integer NOT NULL,
	`_parent_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`quote` text NOT NULL,
	`speaker` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`_parent_id`) REFERENCES `episodes`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

CREATE TABLE `episodes_rels` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`order` integer,
	`parent_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`path` text NOT NULL,
	`guests_id` integer,
	`topics_id` integer,
	FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `episodes`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`guests_id`) REFERENCES `guests`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`topics_id`) REFERENCES `topics`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

CREATE TABLE `episodes_tags` (
	`_order` integer NOT NULL,
	`_parent_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`tag` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`_parent_id`) REFERENCES `episodes`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

CREATE TABLE `guests` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`full_name` text NOT NULL,
	`slug` text NOT NULL,
	`role` text NOT NULL,
	`company` text,
	`short_overview` text NOT NULL,
	`biography` text NOT NULL,
	`portrait_id` integer,
	`portrait_alt` text,
	`portrait_credit` text,
	`links_linkedin` text,
	`links_website` text,
	`links_other` text,
	`featured` integer DEFAULT false,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
	`seo_title` text,
	`seo_description` text,
	`social_image_id` integer,
	`updated_at` text DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL, `canonical_override` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`portrait_id`) REFERENCES `media`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null,
	FOREIGN KEY (`social_image_id`) REFERENCES `media`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null
)

CREATE TABLE `guests_alternate_names` (
	`_order` integer NOT NULL,
	`_parent_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`_parent_id`) REFERENCES `guests`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

CREATE TABLE `guests_key_insights` (
	`_order` integer NOT NULL,
	`_parent_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`quote` text NOT NULL,
	`context` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`_parent_id`) REFERENCES `guests`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

CREATE TABLE `guests_rels` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

	`parent_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`path` text NOT NULL,
	`topics_id` integer,

CREATE TABLE "nominations" (

CREATE TABLE `payload_kv` (

CREATE TABLE `payload_locked_documents` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE `payload_locked_documents_rels` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`order` integer,
	`parent_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`path` text NOT NULL,
	`users_id` integer,
	`guests_id` integer,
	`episodes_id` integer,

CREATE TABLE `payload_migrations` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`name` text,
	`batch` numeric,
	`updated_at` text DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE `payload_preferences` (

	`order` integer,
	`parent_id` integer NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE "redirects" (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

	`to` text NOT NULL,
	`type` text DEFAULT '301' NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE `topics` (

	`name` text NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE `users` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`role` text DEFAULT 'editor' NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) NOT NULL,

guests_key_insights.quote: In deep technology, the greatest trap is optimizing for a demo rather than industrial-scale yield.
True innovation rarely begins with consensus; it begins when physics validates what the market considered impossible.
Capital is commoditized; sovereign strategic patience is the only durable moat in foundational technologies.
Founders who manage through crisis don’t look for certainty—they master decision velocity.
Engineering biology requires the profound humility to listen to four billion years of cellular evolution.
Scientific leadership is about translating mathematical elegance into patient survival.
Software eats the world, but physics still builds the factory floor and the power grid.
Culture is not a poster on the cafeteria wall; it is what your shift managers do when production stops.

episodes.transcript:
Elena Rostova: Thank you for having me. When we founded Quantum Dynamics, everyone asked whether quantum computing would replace GPU clusters...
Host: And your answer was always a decisive no.
Elena Rostova: Exactly. Quantum is not a faster CPU; it is an entirely different domain of mathematics designed for simulation of physics and cryptography...

episodes_key_takeaways.takeaway: Cryogenic yield challenges will determine commercial quantum viability by 2028.
Why compute sovereignty has shifted from an economic policy to a primary defense priority.
The transition from academic experimentation to ISO-certified industrial quantum clusters.
The death of the 3-year SaaS venture fund model in deep industrial verticals.
How institutional LPs evaluate geopolitical risk in supply chain and semiconductor portfolios.
Why decision velocity under incomplete information is the single most predictive founder metric.
Computational protein folding has compressed drug discovery timelines by over 70%.
The critical bottleneck has migrated from molecular design to cold-chain bioreactor manufacturing.
How modern biotech chairs structure research teams to balance academic rigor with commercial speed.
Why brownfield factory automation requires ten times more organizational empathy than greenfield construction.
The economic trade-offs of onshoring manufacturing versus distributed redundancy.
What high-reliability manufacturing principles can teach software and finance leaders.

episodes_quotes.quote: Everyone talks about qubits; the real battle is in cryogenic thermal dissipation at 15 millikelvin.
episodes_quotes.speaker: Elena Rostova

episodes_quotes.quote: When capital was cheap, everybody looked like a strategic genius. Now, operational rigor is once again the only thing that matters.
episodes_quotes.speaker: Marcus Vance

episodes_quotes.quote: We are moving from discovering medicine to programming it.
episodes_quotes.speaker: Dr. Soraya Al-Mansoor

episodes_quotes.quote: If your automated system cannot handle a thirty-minute power fluctuation, you do not have an automated factory—you have an expensive sculpture.
episodes_quotes.speaker: Thomas Sterling
